title: [IMP-13] Attachment encryption is contradictory and the key field is undefined
description: Review finding IMP-13: Attachment encryption is contradictory and the key field is undefined (lens IMP). Location: spec/05-messaging.md:255; spec/14-jmap.md:117; spec/03-spaces.md:190. Fix: As proposed. Checked draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 §Attachment (~/PROJECT/jmap-chat-spec, line 241): its fields are `blobId`, `filename`, `contentType`, `size` and `sha256`, with no key field. So Agora must define the extension field and the blob layout. Full text: notes/review/IMP-verified.md and notes/review/IMP.md.
